missions.name: Dead Stock Identification
missions.query: Find all products with stock count zero across all locations, grouped by supplier and category, and ordered by total value of dead stock

missions.name: Sizing Anomaly Detection
missions.query: Identify products with inconsistent size distributions across different locations, considering the reorder point and last restocked date

missions.name: Supplier Delay Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the lead time of each supplier and calculate the average delay days for products that were not delivered on time, grouped by category and supplier

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Rate Variance
missions.query: Calculate the on-time rate variance for each supplier over the past quarter, considering the lead time and actual delivery dates

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Analysis
missions.query: Identify products with reorder points breached, grouped by supplier and category, and ordered by the total value of breached stock

missions.name: Sales Event Channel Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the sales events by channel and calculate the average units sold per channel, grouped by product category and supplier

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales Event Analysis
missions.query: Identify the top-selling channels for each product category and supplier, considering the units sold and sale date

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Analysis
missions.query: Calculate the inventory turnover ratio for each product category and supplier, considering the stock count, reorder point, and last restocked date
